business.about: Bajaj Finance is mainly engaged in the business of lending. BFL has a diversified lending portfolio across retail, SME and commercial customers with a significant presence in urban and rural India. It also accepts public and corporate deposits and offers variety of financial services products to its customers.(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No:124)

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: I think exiting the year, they would be at INR800 crores a month, and should continue to probably get to INR1,300 crores, INR1,400 crores a month sometime by third quarter of next year.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: I would say probably between 26%, 27% growth we should deliver now on a full year basis.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: I think that's just medium term, we maintain a guidance of 20% to 25% on a year lower here and a year higher there.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: So, we remain comfortable in the longer term, we should be able to sustain a 15% to 18% fee income growth is what I would just say to you, Viral.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: I'm not changing, I must say to you, the longer-term growth guidance of 23% to 25%.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: So, we should start to see as we get in the second half, a double-digit kind of growth momentum in the business.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: I am targeting that next year we should be delivering INR100,000 crores volume between customer centricity, AI and tech transformation and digital transformation, all these three as they come together, that's really what we are aiming to do so that from a push business, we rapidly transition towards being a full business.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: On disbursements, AI, voice and text bots did INR2,500 crores, we will do INR11,000 crores INR12,000 in the full year this year.

items.speaker: Manish Jain
items.quote: As Rajeev is pointing out that we see a 33%, 35% higher increase in ticket size because one is the contribution of Apple to our overall sale has increased vis-a-vis last year.

items.speaker: Manish Jain
items.quote: At an overall level, we see about between a 32% - 33% increase in the ticket size of smartphone.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: I mean this year the digital platform will deliver INR50,000 crores of business.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: If you see since FY20, forget FY21, but even if you take FY18, '19, 4.2%, 4.1%, FY22, 4.2%, FY23, 5.3%, 5.1%, 4.6%, 4.3%.

items.speaker: Sandeep Jain
items.quote: As regard the profit growth for the next year, 22% to 24% growth in AUM should lead to a little better growth in profitability because if we are supposed to deliver Bajaj Finance Limited April 29, 2026 operating efficiency growth of 25% to 40% that Rajeev has talked about, if we see improvement in -- basis points.

items.speaker: Sandeep Jain
items.quote: And based on the current performance that we have delivered and the momentum that we see across businesses, we are reasonably confident that 20% to 24% should be achievable for next year.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: Loan loss to average AUM as what investors have been used to came in at 175 basis points or 1.75% as against 1.97% in same period last year or Q4 FY25.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: Return on equity came in at 20% in the current quarter, we continue to guide for 19% to 20%.

items.speaker: Sandeep Jain
items.quote: I think the long-term guidance that we give at this point in time is between 22% and 24%, 25% kind of corridor.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: In terms of outlook, in terms of operating efficiencies, just on that from an outlook standpoint, given that we are in -- the year is virtually coming to an end, overall, we've taken a view that the top line growth or AUM growth will gravitate between 22% and 23%, but more likely to be 22% on a full year basis.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: It is an improvement of 7 basis points sequentially and COF is expected to be -- we had outlined at the beginning of the year from a guidance standpoint, the number to be between 7.55% to 7.65%.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: CV and tractor, they are small, but should grow 30%, 35%, 40%.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: Based on both these, we think the overall full year growth will be between 22% to 23%.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: You will see on top the reported number, which is 22%, the core growth number, which is 22%.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: The annualized impact is expected to be between INR 100 crores to INR 125 crores annually.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: We expect full year credit cost to be at the upper end of guided range of 1.85% to 1.95% now.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: As a result, we expect full year credit cost to come within 1.85% to 1.95% for FY'26, and we expect significant improvements in credit costs for FY'27.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: So we now would circle up our guidance to 22- 23% growth for full year versus 24-25% that we had pencilled in January'25, when we talked about.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: And we now think the growth will be in the region of 22-23% as compared to our earlier assessment of 24-25% due to a set of risk actions that we have taken in MSME business, and the revised assessment provided by BHFL on its AUM growth for FY '26.

items.speaker: Rajeev Jain
items.quote: For FY '26, we expect cost of funds to be in the region of overall full year to be between 7.5% to 7.55%.

items.speaker: Sandeep Jain
items.quote: All put together, we will see 13% to 15% growth in the current year.
